summary: Taoping Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the immediate resignations of Director and President Zhiqiang Zhao and Chief Marketing Officer Huan Li on August 11, 2026, with no disagreement cited. The board eliminated both offices and will reallocate duties among existing management. On August 12, 2026, the board appointed Bin Ma, current Co-CEO, to fill the director vacancy. Ma has significant management experience and no conflicts. This is a forced/abrupt leadership transition rather than routine, constituting a management change event. No deal terms are involved, and the filing provides no transaction structure.
